questions.cardText:
[Zoology] How does a pack of wild dogs decide when to hunt?
A. By the amount of sleep they had
B. By the number who are awake
C. By voting
Answer: C. Studies on African painted dogs have shown that they vote on this decision by sneezing. They begin hunting when a quorum of sneezes is met. The required number of votes is smaller if it is the pack leader who initiates the vote.
questions.de: Wie „stimmen“ Afrikanische Wildhunde darüber ab, ob das Rudel zur Jagd aufbricht?
questions.en: How do African wild dogs “vote” on whether the pack sets off to hunt?

timeline.labelEn: A study shows African wild dogs use sneezes to vote on leaving to hunt
timeline.labelDe: Eine Studie zeigt, dass Afrikanische Wildhunde per Niesen über den Aufbruch zur Jagd abstimmen

questions.notes: Card confirmed (Walker et al. 2017, Proc. R. Soc. B): if a dominant dog starts, about 3 sneezes guarantee departure; if subordinates start, about 10 are needed.

questions.cardText:
[Linguistic] How did the ancient Egyptians name the word “cat”?
A. It is a word that means “small lion”
B. Based on a sound that cats make
C. The word “Bastet’s guardian”
Answer: B. The ancient Egyptians named the word “cat” as “Mjw,” pronounced similarly to “Meow.”
questions.de: Wie lautete das altägyptische Wort für „Katze“, das höchstwahrscheinlich das Miauen des Tieres nachahmt?
questions.en: What was the ancient Egyptian word for “cat”, most likely imitating the animal's meow?

timeline.labelEn: Old Egyptian is spoken, the stage in which the word mjw (miu) for cat is reconstructed
timeline.labelDe: Altägyptisch wird gesprochen, die Sprachstufe, für die das Wort mjw (miu) für Katze rekonstruiert ist

questions.notes: Card confirmed: Wiktionary calls mjw 'most likely onomatopoeic, from the animal's cry (meow)', conventionally pronounced 'miu'; it properly means a (tom)cat, female mjwt. Wikipedia (Cats in ancient Egypt) gives the transcription mjw.
